Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on target CHEMBL1163123. Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (INNER JOIN for canonical_smiles). Filter to standard_relation '=' and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
